_comment: The update manifest. Serve this at https://tacit.app/latest.json .
Tacit fetches it at most once every 20 hours, sends no identifier and
no version with the request, and never downloads or runs anything from
it - it compares the version and offers a link the user has to click.
Store builds ignore this file entirely; Microsoft and Google do their
own updates and a second updater arguing with theirs is a policy
'url' MUST be https. A manifest is a remote file, and the client
refuses any other scheme rather than put an arbitrary one in front of
Set 'critical' only for a release that fixes something serious. It
overrides a version the user has dismissed. It still waits to be
